summary.overview: The Annual Performance Review and Strategy Discussion meeting between Ahmed and Andrew focused on key company updates and individual roles, highlighting the recent acquisition by Daniel that expands business opportunities. Ahmed’s shift towards a more client-facing role in M&A was discussed, with plans for greater involvement in buy-side campaigns. The meeting also addressed Ahmed's professional development, in which he successfully transitioned to full-time hours and requested a 20% salary increase, which Andrew approved effective February. Furthermore, they reviewed tools and processes, particularly the upcoming migration to Daniel's Go High Level platform and the use of Clay for lead generation, emphasizing the need to focus on buy-side deals for improved returns. Action items were assigned to both participants to foster ongoing professional growth and to streamline workflows.
